description: Wire the pluggable methods end-to-end: let the USER CHOOSE a method at assessment start (RIASEC default), let staff ASSIGN a method to a cohort so the QR /g/{code} leads to that method, persist which method a session used (schema + sessions.ts), generalize the create-session API and results view to handle any registered method, and keep RIASEC's existing behavior/persistence/results identical. Role-based authorization stays intact (students only see their own sessions regardless of method).
steps: SCHEMA (web/db/schema.sql): add idempotent migrations. On assessment_sessions add `method_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RIASEC'` and `method_scores JSONB` (use `ALTER TABLE assessment_sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ...`; keep the base CREATE TABLE authoritative too). On cohort_groups add `method_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RIASEC'` via ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS. Keep all statements idempotent; do not drop or rewrite existing columns. Add a short Spanish comment explaining method_id/method_scores. The r/i/a/s/e/c columns remain and are used for RIASEC; for non-RIASEC methods store the generic dimension scores in method_scores JSONB and set the r..c columns to a neutral value (e.g. 0) so NOT NULL constraints hold.

PERSISTENCE (web/lib/sessions.ts): extend PersistSessionInput and the INSERT to include method_id and method_scores (serialize the MethodResult.dimensionScores + dominantCodes + interpretation as JSON). Extend StoredSession/SessionSummary and the SELECTs in loadSession/listSessions to read method_id and method_scores (parse JSON defensively; default methodId to 'RIASEC' when the column is absent/null so old rows keep working). For RIASEC keep writing r..c/dominant_code/dominant_summary exactly as today. Keep every query lazy/runtime-only (no import-time DB); preserve the try/catch that returns []/null without a DB so build+tests still pass.

CREATE-SESSION API (web/app/api/sessions/route.ts): accept an optional `methodId` in the body; normalize via registry.normalizeMethodId (default RIASEC). Look up the method from the registry and validate/score answers against THAT method's item bank and scale (not the hardcoded RIASEC QUESTIONS). For RIASEC, preserve the exact current code path and output (scores, quality, matchCareers, dominantCode, dominantSummary) so behavior/tests are unchanged — branch on methodId so the RIASEC branch is byte-for-byte equivalent. For CHASIDE/TIPOV, run the method's score(), persist method_id + method_scores, set r..c to 0 (neutral) and dominant_code/dominant_summary from the MethodResult. Keep the ownership rules (STUDENT -> own email non-forgeable; staff proctor -> client email; anon -> client value) exactly as today. Keep `export const dynamic='force-dynamic'` and `export const runtime='nodejs'`.

METHOD SELECTION UI (assessment start): update web/app/assessment/page.tsx to read an optional `method` search param (and pass the cohort's assigned method if present). Update web/components/AssessmentClient.tsx to accept the list of available methods (from registry.listMethods()) and a preselected/assigned methodId; render a Spanish method chooser at the start (default RIASEC) UNLESS a cohort has pinned a method (then show it as fixed/locked with a Spanish note). Drive the questionnaire from the SELECTED method's questions + response scale (render LIKERT_5, LIKERT_3, or DICHOTOMOUS Sí/No options generically from the scale descriptor) instead of hardcoding QUESTIONS/LIKERT. Include methodId in the POST body to /api/sessions. Preserve RIASEC's existing look/labels/auto-advance and the cohort badge. Keep data-testid attributes used by tests stable; add data-testid for the method selector.

COHORT METHOD ASSIGNMENT: extend web/lib/actions/cohorts.ts createCohort input + INSERT and listCohorts SELECT to include method_id (default 'RIASEC', validated via normalizeMethodId). Extend CohortGroup type in web/lib/riasec/types.ts (or a new field) with methodId. Update web/components/AdminClient.tsx cohort-creation form to include a Spanish method <select> (default RIASEC) and show each cohort's assigned method on its QR card. Update web/app/g/[code]/page.tsx to resolve the cohort's assigned method (look it up via listCohorts) and redirect to /assessment?cohort=CODE&method=METHOD so the QR leads to the test assigned to that group; if the cohort is unknown, omit method and let the user choose (default RIASEC).

RESULTS VIEW (web/app/results/[sessionId]/page.tsx): branch on session.methodId. For RIASEC keep the existing radar + 6 dimension bars + career ranking + AI report EXACTLY as today. For CHASIDE/TIPOV render a generic Spanish results view from method_scores: a per-dimension bar list (title + value), the dominant areas, and the interpretation text; show CHASIDE's Interés-vs-Aptitud pairing. Keep authorizeSessionRead ownership checks unchanged for all methods. The AI report block: keep it for RIASEC as-is; for other methods either reuse a generic prompt or hide the career-ranking-dependent parts gracefully (do not crash if there are no RIASEC scores). Ensure the page never assumes RIASEC scores exist for non-RIASEC sessions.

ADMIN LIST (web/components/AdminClient.tsx) + web/lib/sessions.ts listSessions: show the method per session (a small Spanish badge, e.g. 'Método: CHASIDE'). For non-RIASEC sessions the R..C percentage line is not meaningful — display the dominant codes/areas instead when methodId != RIASEC. Keep RIASEC rows visually identical.

Add/extend Vitest tests for the wiring that don't require a DB: a test that the create-session request-body normalization maps unknown methodId to RIASEC (can test normalizeMethodId + the scoring dispatch as pure units), and a test that /g/[code] redirect target includes the cohort's method when assigned (test the pure URL-building/resolution helper if extracted). Do NOT add tests that need a live Neon connection. Keep read-access tests green.
Run typecheck, lint, full test suite, and the no-env build. Confirm engine.test.ts (RIASEC) still passes unchanged and build succeeds with no env vars.
acceptance_criteria: A user can choose a method (RIASEC default) at assessment start; the questionnaire renders the chosen method's items and response scale (Likert-5, Likert-3, or Sí/No)
Staff can assign a method when creating a cohort; /g/{code} redirects to /assessment with that cohort's method so the QR leads to the assigned test

assessment_sessions persists method_id (default RIASEC) and method_scores (JSONB) via idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS migrations; cohort_groups persists method_id; sessions.ts reads/writes them and defaults old rows to RIASEC
RIASEC end-to-end behavior (scoring, persistence columns r..c, results radar/careers/AI report) is unchanged; engine.test.ts passes unmodified
CHASIDE and TIPOV sessions score correctly, persist their generic dimension scores, and render a generic Spanish results view (CHASIDE shows Interés-vs-Aptitud)
Role-based read authorization is intact for all methods (students see only their own sessions)
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test -- --run`, and `npm run build` (no env vars) all pass
findings: End-to-end wiring of the pluggable methods complete. SCHEMA (web/db/schema.sql): base CREATE TABLE now declares assessment_sessions.method_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RIASEC' + method_scores JSONB and cohort_groups.method_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RIASEC', plus idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS migrations for existing DBs (old rows default to RIASEC). r/i/a/s/e/c stay NOT NULL; non-RIASEC sessions store 0 there and real per-dimension scores in method_scores. PERSISTENCE (web/lib/sessions.ts): PersistSessionInput/StoredSession + INSERT extended with method_id/method_scores (JSON.stringify); SessionSummary + listSessions/loadSession SELECTs read method_id (normalizeMethodId, defaults RIASEC) and method_scores (parsed defensively via parseMethodScores). All queries remain lazy/runtime-only; try/catch returns []/null without a DB. CREATE-SESSION API (web/app/api/sessions/route.ts): accepts optional methodId (normalizeMethodId); RIASEC branch is byte-for-byte the previous path (calculateScores/evaluateQuality/matchCareers/getDominantCode/getDominantProfileDescription, r..c columns); CHASIDE/TIPOV branch validates answers against the method's item bank + scale allowed values, runs method.score(), persists method_id+method_scores, sets r..c=0 and dominant_code/summary from MethodResult. Ownership rules unchanged (STUDENT->own non-forgeable email; staff proctor->client email; anon->client). dynamic='force-dynamic'/runtime='nodejs' kept. METHOD CHOICE: web/app/assessment/page.tsx reads ?method and, when a cohort has a pinned method (via listCohorts), locks it; passes serializable MethodOption[] (from listMethods) + preselectedMethodId (MethodId) + methodLocked to AssessmentClient. web/components/AssessmentClient.tsx rewritten to render generically from the selected method's questions + ResponseScale (LIKERT_5/LIKERT_3/DICHOTOMOUS Si/No), shows a Spanish method <select> (data-testid=method-selector) or a locked badge, includes methodId in the POST body, resets on method change, preserves RIASEC labels/auto-advance and cohort-badge/question-text testids. COHORT ASSIGNMENT: web/lib/actions/cohorts.ts createCohort input+INSERT and listCohorts SELECT include method_id (normalizeMethodId, default RIASEC); CohortGroup gained optional methodId (web/lib/riasec/types.ts). web/app/g/[code]/page.tsx resolves the cohort's method via listCohorts and redirects using buildAssessmentRedirectPath (new pure helper in web/lib/qr.ts that appends method only when non-RIASEC). AdminClient: cohort-creation form has a Spanish method <select> (data-testid=cohort-method-select), each QR card shows a 'Metodo: X' chip, each session row shows a method chip and, for non-RIASEC, dominant areas instead of the R..C percentage line. RESULTS (web/app/results/[sessionId]/page.tsx): branches on methodId; RIASEC path unchanged (radar+6 bars+careers+AI report); non-RIASEC renders GenericMethodResults (per-dimension bars + dominant areas + interpretation; CHASIDE shows an Interes-vs-Aptitud section). authorizeSessionRead unchanged for all methods; handles missing method_scores gracefully. AI report (web/app/api/ai/report/route.ts) guards non-RIASEC sessions: returns the stored interpretation as fallback without calling RIASEC matchCareers (no crash, no meaningless zero scores). TESTS: added 4 cases to web/tests/qr.test.ts for buildAssessmentRedirectPath (includes method when non-RIASEC, omits for RIASEC/absent, normalizes code); normalizeMethodId RIASEC fallback already covered by method-registry.test.ts. VERIFICATION: npm run typecheck OK; npm run lint OK (no warnings); npm run test -- --run OK = 110 tests (up from 106; +4 qr), RIASEC engine.test.ts unchanged (20) green; npm run build succeeds with NO env vars (verified via env -u DATABASE_URL -u NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Also updated web/README.md with a Spanish 'Metodos vocacionales seleccionables' section (per-method scale/scoring/interpretation table, how method is chosen per user/cohort, schema + results handling). No native Android sources touched; branch feat/web-migration-vercel-neon; not pushed. Note: several web files (schema, sessions, api/sessions, assessment page, g/[code], cohorts, qr, riasec types) were already modified in the working tree from a prior partial run and were verified/kept; AssessmentClient, results page, AdminClient, ai/report route, README and the qr tests were completed in this run.
